author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Fix the inverted tracked logic in the `Entry` constructors.

Sort the `Entry` type names by ASCII value to make `std::lower_bound` work correctly, and add a compile time check that the `Entry` type names are sorted.

Add a new unit test building an `Entry` from its type name and encoded value: build tracked and untracked Entry objects of all types from their type name and encoded value, and compare them with the original ones.

#### PR validation:

Existing and new unit tests pass.


#### Backport status

Backport of #52221 to 17.0.x.
title: [17.0] Fix `ParameterSet` `Entry` constructor and type names
